*   `?g A4`: Main Concept is Fauna/Animal.
    *   `+ White`: White color associated with the main concept.
    *   `+ E1`: Cold/Snow/Rain/Cloud associated with the main concept.
    *   `+ G10`: Big/High/Large associated with the main concept.

    *   Animal (A4)
    *   White (White)
    *   Cold/Snow/Arctic (E1)
    *   Big/Large (G10)

    *   Polar Bear (White, Cold/Arctic, Big)
    *   Arctic Fox (White, Cold, but usually smaller than a bear, though G10 is "Big")
    *   Walrus (White/Grey-ish, Cold, Big)
    *   Narwhal (White, Cold, Big)
    *   Whale (White/Blue, Cold, Big) - but usually whales aren't primarily "White" in a defining way like a polar bear.
    *   Snowy Owl (White, Cold, but G10 is "Big", owl is medium).

    *   "Polar bear" is the most iconic fit for white, cold, and big animal.

    1. Polar bear
    2. Arctic fox
    3. Snowy owl
